---
name: AnimeDar colon-joined slug
description: Titles with colons (Re:Zero) need colon-removed slug variant for AnimeDar URLs
---

AnimeDar generates slugs by removing colons entirely and joining the two parts:
- `Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu 4th Season` → `rezero-kara-hajimeru-isekai-seikatsu-4th-season`

But `toSlug("Re:Zero...")` produces `re-zero-kara-...` (colon becomes space, space becomes hyphen) — a DIFFERENT slug.

**Fix:** In `searchAnimedar`, add a slug candidate generated by removing colons first:
```js
const colonJoined = toSlug(q.replace(/[：:]/g, ""));
if (colonJoined && colonJoined !== s) slugCandidates.push(colonJoined);
```

**Why:** AnimeDar's URL generation joins the pre/post-colon parts without a separator. Standard `toSlug` inserts a hyphen where the colon was (via the space-to-hyphen transformation).

**How to apply:** Any Arabic anime site using slug-based URLs may follow this pattern for colon-containing titles (Fate:Zero, Re:Zero, Re:Creators, etc.). Add the colonJoined variant to other scrapers' slug candidates too if they show similar failures.
